contea di ritrovamento: Cheshire East (Inghilterra e Galles)

A lead object, possibly a curse tablet or votive dating to the Roman period. The object consists of a sub-rectangular strip of lead which has been rolled up. It is tubular in shape. There are no markings on the outer surface of the object
